# A nil-result defer f()? in a loop allocates nothing under logos and, in
# ejected Go, one closure per iteration plus one box for the error
# result, because plain Go has no pooled record [T-104.2]. A statement
# outside a loop allocates nothing in either build.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
stdout '^loop-allocs 0$'
stdout '^single-allocs 0$'

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go

cd out
go run .
stdout '^loop-allocs 6$'
stdout '^single-allocs 0$'
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
stdout '^loop-allocs 6$'
stdout '^single-allocs 0$'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/defereject

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
)

var sinkErr error

//go:noinline
func closeNil() error { return nil }

func loop(n int) (err error) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		defer closeNil()?
	}
	return nil
}

//go:noinline
func single() (err error) {
	defer closeNil()?
	return nil
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("loop-allocs", int(testing.AllocsPerRun(200, func() { sinkErr = loop(5) })))
	fmt.Println("single-allocs", int(testing.AllocsPerRun(200, func() { sinkErr = single() })))
}
